jobs.occupation: Senior AI Engineer - Agentic Systems & LLMs (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
In everything we do and in everything we say, we strive for the best possible ways to help our business serve our patients.
By putting our colleagues in Drug Development Departments for chemical and biological entities (CMC) at the center of our actions, we jointly identify, develop, and implement innovations that enable faster and better decisions across the overall Boehringer Ingelheim pipeline. With the rapid advent of generative AI, LLMs, and agentic technologies, we have the opportunity to accelerate this dramatically and fundamentally change the way we work. Only very few IT roles offer such a direct connection to Boehringer Ingelheim's scientific value chain.
As our Senior System Engineer for Agentic AI / LLM solutions, you will help shape the transformation of CMC into the era of generative and agentic AI. You will work hands-on with and for our business to develop solutions ranging from simple agents to designing and building complex solutions from scratch, while also driving implementation and upskilling initiatives that accelerate the adoption of these technologies across CMC.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you will design, develop, deploy, operate, and continuously enhance highly complex and globally distributed GenAI agents, multi-agent systems, workflow automations, and data integrations
- You will develop production-ready solutions based on modern software engineering, DevOps, and AI-assisted development practices
- Working closely with business stakeholders, you will identify, prioritize, develop, and deliver AI-based use cases that drive measurable business value while adhering to security, privacy, and Responsible AI standards
- You will explore and evaluate the latest GenAI, LLM, and agentic technologies, turning innovative ideas into scalable solutions that accelerate business value and enhance future readiness
- You will shape the foundation for scalable AI innovation by defining governance frameworks, operating models, and architectural standards that drive the successful development and continuous improvement of GenAI, LLM, and agent-based solutions.
- Act as a trusted advisor and AI ambassador—driving adoption through community building, stakeholder engagement, onboarding initiatives, and targeted upskilling programs across our business and IT partners﻿

Requirements

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, or a related field, combined with several years of relevant professional experience in AI, software engineering, digital innovation, or related disciplines.
- Hands-on experience designing and implementing LLM-based agents, multi-agent systems, workflow automations, and data integrations (e.g., using Python, modern API frameworks, orchestration frameworks, or MCP/tool-calling patterns).
- Proven experience developing, deploying, and maintaining software solutions in enterprise environments using modern software engineering, containerization, CI/CD, and AI-assisted development practices.
- Proven experience establishing scalable architectural standards, LLMOps practices, and governance structures for GenAI, LLM, and agent-based solutions.
- Ability to work directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into practical technology-based solutions, applying structured problem-solving approaches and integrating relevant data sources.
- Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, mentor colleagues, and foster the adoption of best practices in AI solution development.
- Nice-to-have: Good understanding of pharmaceutical development and CMC processes (e.g., process/analytical development, formulation, or manufacturing science) and GxP-regulated environments.
- Strong communication, consulting, and collaboration skills, combined with a pragmatic, hands-on mindset and the ability to rapidly turn ideas into practical solutions.
- Excellent written and spoken English skills.

Start date: asap
As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

communication, initiative and ownership. You should be comfortable engaging with

schedules, dependencies and resource constraints.

constructively.

You provide clear technical recommendations and evidence to support informed decisions at system and aircraft level.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Own a complete, consistent, and traceable requirements baseline for the electric propulsion system, translating aircraft, safety, certification, and programme needs into system and equipment requirements.

• An engineering degree or equivalent qualification in aerospace, electrical, systems, control engineering, or a related discipline.
• Extensive systems engineering experience with complex technical products.
• Deep technical understanding of electric propulsion systems, including electric motors, inverters, propulsion controls, and their electrical, thermal, and mechanical integration.
• Experience in aviation or a comparably regulated industry, such as space, automotive, or defence.
• A strong command of requirements engineering, traceability, technical baseline management, and the assessment of design changes.

You’ll further develop our in-house modules, continue the migration to the Odoo standard, integrate new countries, standardize payment processes, and build our new online store—ensuring it’s fully upgradeable, with streamlined workflows and genuine creative freedom.
Your mission
• The focus is on further developing our Odoo platform—which includes approximately 25 in-house modules—and upgrading it to the target version. In doing so, you’ll rely on an upgrade-friendly architecture based on inheritance rather than modifications to the Odoo core
• Another key focus of your work will be migrating existing processes to the Odoo standard and integrating new countries—including localization, accounting, and country-specific requirements

jobs.occupation: Modelling Scientist (f/m/d) (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
Purpose of your Job

Our Science and Technology team is looking for a Modelling Scientist to advance data-driven drug development through cutting-edge computational approaches.
In this role, you will apply mechanistic models, machine learning, and molecular simulations to predict the stability and behaviour of biopharmaceutical products. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate modelling into experimental workflows and support innovative, model-informed development strategies.

Are you passionate about scientific modelling and pharmaceutical innovation?
Join us and shape the future of computational drug development—apply today!

Your Responsibility

- Act as a scientific contributor in cross-functional research and development projects, supporting the integration of advanced modelling approaches into biopharmaceutical development.
- Develop, validate, and apply advanced computational models to simulate the physical and chemicals stability, as well as the behaviour, of biopharmaceutical drug products.
- Integrate experimental and structural data into predictive modelling frameworks.
- Utilize a range of modelling techniques, including mechanistic models, machine learning approaches, and molecular simulations, to generate actionable scientific insights.
- Contribute to the development of internal modelling platforms, tools, and workflows to enhance scalability and reproducibility.
- Design and execute simulation studies to investigate formulations parameters, degradation pathways, and process related risks.
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including formulation scientists, analytical experts, and business developers to align modelling strategies with project objectives.
- Analyse and interpret complex data to generate actionable insights.
- Translate and present complex modelling outcomes into clear, impactful recommendations for internal stakeholders and project teams.
- Ensure model quality through rigorous validation procedures and documentation, following internal standards and regulatory expectations where applicable.
- Drive continuous innovation by exploring and implementing state-of-the-art computational approaches relevant to pharmaceutical formulation science.
- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of developments in computational modelling, data science, and biopharmaceutical development to ensure the scientific relevance and competitiveness of modelling approaches.
- Contribute to scientific excellence by co-authoring peer-reviewed publications.
- Support regulatory submissions by providing modelling data and documentation as needed.

What you need to succeed

- Master’s degree or higher in Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field (PhD preferred)
- Formal training or academic coursework in mechanistic modelling, machine learning, bioinformatics, or molecular dynamics is advantageous.
- 2–5 years of experience in pharmaceutical research and computational modelling, ideally with exposure to protein- and nucleic acid-based therapeutics.
- Strong programming and data analysis skills, with proficiency in tools such as Python, MATLAB, or R, and familiarity with modelling and simulation libraries.
- Expertise in mechanistic modelling, machine learning, molecular modelling, or molecular dynamics simulations.
- Solid understanding of biopharmaceutical products, including structure-function relationships, degradation mechanisms, and formulation challenges.
- Experience in integrating computational models into experimental workflows and interdisciplinary project settings.
- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with a track record of scientific contributions such as peer-reviewed publications or conference presentations.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex modelling results into clear insights for diverse audiences.
- Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
- Collaborative and team-oriented mindset with a proactive and open approach to interdisciplinary work.
- A passion for scientific innovation, curiosity, and a commitment to staying at the forefront of computational and pharmaceutical science.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber: 
Grundkenntnisse: Modellbildung, Simulation (IT)
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Molekularbiologie, Arzneimittelinformation, Angewandte Informatik, Galenik, Modellierungs- und Simulationssprache SystemC, KI-Detektoren, Mathematik, Data Fabric
Expertenkenntnisse: Bioinformatik, Programmiersprache R, Machine Learning, Angewandte Mathematik, Biomathematik, Laborarbeiten, Labortechnik, Datenvisualisierung, Data Science, Data Engineering, Quantitative Forschungsmethode
Zwingend erforderlich: Pharmazeutische Technologie, Forschung, Arzneimittelentwicklung, Programmiersprache Python, Analysis

The position is located at the Department of Trauma and Orthopedic Surgery, University Hospital Erlangen, within the research group Musculoskeletal Inflammation in Traumatology, led by Prof. Jana Riegger-Koch. Our research focuses on the cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying musculoskeletal diseases, particularly osteoporosis, impaired fracture healing, and age-related and post-traumatic osteoarthritis. Two central research pillars are the complement system and its role in inflammation and tissue degeneration, and cell fate decisions in response to cellular stress and injury, including differentiation, senescence, and cell death. We aim to translate these mechanistic insights into novel therapeutic strategies for tissue protection and regeneration. More information: www.riegger-lab.de ( https://www.riegger-lab.de/ )

- Participate in teaching activities, including practical courses and lectures
- Present research findings at national and international scientific conferences
- Prepare scientific manuscripts and contribute to grant applications

Qualifications

- PhD in life sciences, such as molecular medicine, biology, or a related discipline
- Strong background in musculoskeletal diseases, mitochondria, immunology, and/or molecular biology
- Hands-on experience in cell culture techniques, fluorescence microscopy, molecular biological techniques (e.g., qRT-PCR, siRNA transfection, and others), Western blotting, and/or histology
- Excellent written and spoken English skills

Additional advantages

- Experience in bioinformatics, omics technologies, or single-cell analysis
- Experience in supervising students, preparing grant applications, or working with laboratory animals
- A strong publication record
- German language skills

Global investment in industrial plants and infrastructure is being driven by evolving technologies, resilient supply chains, the energy transition and growing demand for critical resources. Munich Re F&C provides tailored insurance solutions for complex international construction projects, including oil, gas, chemicals and petrochemicals, mining and mineral processing, battery and semiconductor manufacturing, and emerging energy technologies such as green hydrogen, carbon capture and eSAF. As part of our Construction team, you will combine engineering expertise with commercial decision-making. We welcome applicants from insurance, industry, project development, EPC contracting and risk engineering. Prior underwriting experience is not essential if you bring relevant technical or contract expertise, sound judgement and a willingness to learn the insurance business.
Your Job

- Assess and underwrite complex international construction and industrial projects in line with Munich Re's strategy, risk appetite and delegated authority.
- Analyse technical, contractual and commercial information, identify key risk drivers and uncertainties, and document the decision process.
- Develop tailored insurance solutions that balance client needs, risk quality and sustainable profitability.
- Identify attractive business opportunities and contribute to profitable growth, portfolio quality, and diversification.
- Build trusted relationships with brokers, insureds and project stakeholders, and represent Munich Re at client meetings, project presentations and market events.
- Participate in or lead site surveys and translate findings into reports.
- Collaborate with colleagues and specialist experts, support the global Munich Re organisation and contribute to underwriting methods, tools and knowledge sharing.

Your Profile

- A university degree in engineering, natural sciences or other relevant technical disciplines, or a recognised insurance qualification with a strong interest in technical risks.
- Professional experience in process-driven industries, equipment manufacturing or another relevant technical environment, or experience in construction project insurance.
- The ability to understand complex industrial processes, project structures, and to derive clear conclusions from complex or incomplete information.
- The ability to familiarize yourself quickly with new topics, work independently, take ownership and make well-reasoned decisions.
- Strong communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills, combined with a constructive and solution-oriented approach.
- The ability to analyse technical and contractual documents and the motivation to develop expertise in insurance contracts and policy wordings.
- Curiosity about industrial sectors and emerging technologies, combined with an international and collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across cultures and functions.
- Fluent written and spoken English is required for working in an international business environment. German, Spanish or other relevant language skills are an advantage.
- Willingness to travel internationally.
